reviews.text: Had both of my larger dogs groomed at sparkle with Jayla. The staff was caring/kind and took great care of my babies.
They do an excellent job of grooming and trimming our cavapoo. We come here monthly and she always comes home looking great! Here are photos from her last few grooms. Highly recommend this spot!
Our dog Norman has been going to this location for a little while now and they’ve always done a great job! The unlimited membership is definitely worth it if you take your dog consistently.
Fantastic membership options
Jayla did a wonderful job on my boy Kodi!!! His coat feel amazing! And he came back happy♥️We will definitely be requesting her again!

We used to go to the San Tan location, but this location opened and is a lot closer. We love this location so much more. I almost want to gatekeep so they don't get too busy or raise prices. Unlike the other location they have plenty of appointment times and you don't have to book two months out. Everyone is so friendly and the dogs behave really well. Which again was not our experience at the San Tan location. The prices are so affordable compared to taking them to get groomed elsewhere.

So awesome and quick!
They did both my dogs
My husky literally looks so different we’re so happy with the results! 😭
Rugo and Sam thank you <3
Thank you for your review! ✨

Take your dog here for exceptional, above and beyond service!! Our dog Alo (ignore our kitty posing for a picture too haha) is a husky shepherd mix and has a double coat. We get the shed pro along with an essentials package and extra teeth cleaning. She comes out looking, feeling, and smelling AMAZING!! The staff there is so friendly and treats her like they’re own, which is such a piece of mind after dropping her off. All of them are great but Erica went above and beyond taking care of every little detail, which we appreciate so so much!! 5 starts every time!!😊

We were so disappointed when our regular groomer left at another location, and unfortunately, our boy’s next haircut didn’t turn out quite right. I stopped in and showed Starla what I was seeing, and she immediately understood. She happened to have an opening about an hour later and fit him in.

When I picked him up, I was blown away by the correction and blending—she did an incredible job! I had read that Starla was the highest-rated groomer at this location, and now I completely understand why. We’re sad to have lost our previous groomer, but thanks to Starla, we once again feel confident that our boy is in great hands. Highly recommend her!
My dog always leaves Sparkle so clean and happy! We recently got the membership and have been bringing her regularly, each time has been a great experience!
Super friendly and courteous people and they handled our puppy with care

WOW!!!!! We feel so lucky to have found sparkle or Dog Coco loves going to get groomed here. Our favorite is Starla. She is so sweet with Coco and always gives her such a good haircut. We do the unlimited membership and it is such a good value! I highly recommend sparkle to anyone to  needs a good place to take their dog to get groomed.

I was referred to Sparkle Grooming by my friend who has an Aussie-Doodle. Behlou grooms this particular pup and does a phenomenal job.  I brought my dog, Freya (Lab/Aussie mix), to Behlou and Freya came back looking great. She had an extra pep in her step because Behlou took such great care of her. We will definitely be back to Sparkle!
We love Sparkle! Thank you for the great work, Behlou!
I recommend Sparkle to anyone in the neighborhood. Christian in particular takes great care of our doodle. Once our pup met Christian she is much less anxious and always comes out looking dapper!

We love Sparkle! Our Goldendoodle is often a little afraid of getting groomed, but everyone at Sparkle has been so nice and gentle with her. We are especially grateful to Jayla, who is so calm and patient with her grooming, and Della, who gives the best haircuts!
Have been a member for a couple of months great staff ! Such a good deal they know how to get the job done ! penny love it here !

We’ve been coming to Sparkle for a very long time! My big dog Luna LOVES seeing Cris!!! The deshedding has been SO helpful with reducing the amount of hair I have to vacuum up daily too! Having a long haired Saint Bernard is not for the weak, but Sparkle and Cris have been a God sent 😩😩

Behlou is the absolute best. She takes care of and loves on Goose ❤️ highly recommend her, the unlimited membership, and the moisturizer for paws and nose (made his paws the softest they’ve been this summer)
